saw_lines: Supplement buyers want to know how an order arrives before they commit, and they often reorder the same tub without thinking.
So the delivery answer has to sit in the first line of the ad, before a buyer decides to scroll past.
Your shipping policy page answers delivery, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so open three new video ads with one delivery line taken from that policy.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your shipping policy page answers how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A first buyer gets no answer in the ad itself. Open three new video ads with one line on delivery, taken from that policy.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a buyer has no reason to trust the claims yet. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open three ads with it on the creative.
0 of 20 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer gets no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to act today, a first order offer or a bundle, and put it in line one of three ads.

Your 20 copy ads open 12 different ways, and the biggest opener leads 3 ads, so buyers see scattered messages. Pick the two strongest openings and build your next batch from them, three variations each, naming the product in line one.

ads_1: Delivery and first order offer in line one, tested against your prep story openers
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
